title: Grammar Hook: Subject-Verb Agreement
body: Read this: 'My group of friends are coming.' vs 'My group of friends is coming.' Which is correct? Most students get this wrong! Today we master the golden rules that make your English instantly correct.
body_hi: पढ़ें: 'My group of friends are coming.' बनाम 'My group of friends is coming.' कौन सा सही है? Subject-Verb Agreement का अर्थ है कि Subject और Verb हमेशा मेल खाना चाहिए।
body_gu: 'My group of friends is/are coming?' — S-V Agreement = Subject-Verb must match.

question: Before we study Subject-Verb Agreement, can you try to identify the error in this sentence: 'She go to school every day'?
question_hi: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता सीखने से पहले, क्या आप इस वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचान सकते हैं?
explanation: Think about it! This is exactly what Subject-Verb Agreement helps us fix. Let us discover the rules together.
explanation_hi: यही कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता सही करने में मदद करता है।

title: Discover: Subject-Verb Agreement in Real Life
title_hi: खोज: वास्तविक जीवन में कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता
body: Look around you — Subject-Verb Agreement appears in every English text you read, every exam you write, every email you send. Mastering Subject-Verb Agreement = mastering English communication.
body_hi: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता हर अंग्रेजी पाठ में, हर परीक्षा में, हर ईमेल में दिखाई देता है। कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता में महारत = अंग्रेजी संचार में महारत।
body_gu: Subject-Verb Agreement — everywhere in English. Master it = master English.

title: The 10 Golden Rules of Subject-Verb Agreement
body:
1. Singular subject → singular verb: He runs.
2. Plural subject → plural verb: They run.
3. 'Each/Every/Either/Neither' + singular verb: Each child is happy.
4. Collective nouns → singular verb: The team wins.
5. 'One of the + plural' → singular verb: One of the boys was absent.
6. 'A number of' → plural: A number of students are present.
7. 'The number of' → singular: The number of students is increasing.
8. Indefinite pronouns (everyone, nobody) → singular: Everyone is invited.
9. Two subjects joined by 'and' → plural: Ram and Shyam are brothers.
10. 'Either/Neither + or/nor' → verb agrees with NEARER subject.
body_hi:
1. एकवचन Subject → एकवचन Verb
2. बहुवचन Subject → बहुवचन Verb
3. Each/Every/Either/Neither → एकवचन
4. Collective nouns → एकवचन
5. One of the + plural → एकवचन
6. A number of → बहुवचन
7. The number of → एकवचन
8. Everyone/Nobody → एकवचन
9. And से जुड़े दो Subject → बहुवचन
10. Either...or/Neither...nor → निकटतम Subject से मेल
body_gu:
10 Rules:
1. Singular→Singular. 2. Plural→Plural. 3. Each/Every→Singular. 4. Collective→Singular. 5. One of the→Singular. 6. A number of→Plural. 7. The number of→Singular. 8. Everyone→Singular. 9. A and B→Plural. 10. Either/Nor→Nearer Subject.

title: Board Exam Tip: Subject-Verb Agreement
body: In CBSE Class 9 board exam, Subject-Verb Agreement questions appear in: (1) Fill in the blanks (2) Editing/Omission exercises (3) Rearranging jumbled sentences (4) Sentence transformation. Always justify your answer with the rule!

title: Solved Example 1: Subject-Verb Agreement
title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 1: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता
solution: IS. Rule: Some nouns look plural but are treated as SINGULAR: news, mathematics, physics, politics, economics, athletics, measles, mumps. → 'The news is shocking.'
solution_hi: IS। नियम: कुछ संज्ञाएं बहुवचन दिखती हैं लेकिन एकवचन मानी जाती हैं: news, mathematics, physics।
solution_gu: IS. Special nouns: news, maths, physics → always singular.

title: Solved Example 2: Subject-Verb Agreement
title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 2: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता
problem: Either the teacher or the students _____ (is/are) responsible.
problem_hi: या तो शिक्षक या छात्र जिम्मेदार _____ (is/are)।
solution: ARE. Rule: Either...or / Neither...nor → verb agrees with the NEARER subject. 'students' is nearer → plural → ARE.
solution_hi: ARE। नियम: Either...or में क्रिया निकटतम Subject से मेल खाती है। 'students' निकट है → बहुवचन → ARE।

title: Solved Example 3: Subject-Verb Agreement
title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 3: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता
problem_hi: बहुत से छात्र पास _____ (has/have) हुए हैं।
solution: HAVE. Rule: 'A NUMBER OF' = many → PLURAL verb. 'THE NUMBER OF' = a count → SINGULAR verb. Example: 'The number of students IS increasing.'
solution_hi: HAVE। नियम: 'A number of' = बहुत → बहुवचन। 'The number of' = संख्या → एकवचन।
solution_gu: 'A number of' = plural. 'The number of' = singular.

question: _____ of the boys (has/have) completed the homework.
question_hi: लड़कों में से किसी ने _____ गृहकार्य पूरा किया है।
explanation: 'Neither' refers to exactly two people/things and ALWAYS takes a SINGULAR verb. → 'Neither of the boys HAS completed the homework.'
explanation_hi: 'Neither' दो में से किसी को संदर्भित करता है और हमेशा एकवचन क्रिया लेता है।

question: The committee _____ divided on this issue.
explanation: Collective nouns (committee, team, jury, family, government, audience) take SINGULAR verb when acting as ONE unit. 'The committee IS divided' (acting as one body).
explanation_hi: Collective nouns (committee, team, jury) एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं जब एक इकाई के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।

question: Board Exam — Editing: 'Mathematics are my favourite subject.' Correct the error.
question_hi: Board Editing: 'Mathematics are my favourite subject.' — सुधारें।
question_gu: Board Edit: 'Mathematics are my favourite subject.'
explanation: Mathematics (like news, physics, economics, politics) ends in 's' but is a SINGULAR subject, so it takes singular verb IS. → 'Mathematics IS my favourite subject.'
explanation_hi: Mathematics एकवचन विषय है, इसलिए IS → 'Mathematics IS my favourite subject.'

question: Each of the players _____ given a trophy.
question_hi: प्रत्येक खिलाड़ी को एक ट्रॉफी _____ दी गई।
question_gu: Each of the players _____ given trophy.
explanation: 'Each' always takes a SINGULAR verb. 'Each of the players WAS given a trophy.' Remember: Each, Every, Either, Neither → always singular.
explanation_hi: 'Each' हमेशा एकवचन क्रिया लेता है। 'Each of the players WAS given a trophy.'

question: Board Exam: 'A large number of birds _____ migrated to warmer climates.'
question_hi: Board: 'बड़ी संख्या में पक्षी गर्म जलवायु की ओर _____ प्रवास कर गए हैं।'
question_gu: Board: 'A large number of birds _____ migrated.'
explanation: 'A large number of' = MANY → PLURAL verb HAVE. vs 'The number of birds IS increasing' (singular). KEY TRICK: A number of = many birds (plural). The number of = how many (singular count).
explanation_hi: 'A large number of' = अनेक → बहुवचन HAVE।

title: Reflect & Apply
body: Write 5 sentences of your own using Subject-Verb Agreement. Try to use as many rules as you have learnt today. Then, check if you have used the rules correctly.
body_hi: कर्ता-क्रिया अनुरूपता का उपयोग करके अपने 5 वाक्य लिखें।
body_gu: Subject-Verb Agreement use karke 5 sentences lakho.
